1. [DATA LOADING] Load all three datasets (MovieLens100K, Amazon2014VideoGames, HetrecLastFM) using `RecSysDataSet.use_dataloader()` with the corresponding `DataSet` enum values (`DataSet.MovieLens100K`, `DataSet.Amazon2014VideoGames`, `DataSet.HetrecLastFM`).
2. [CORE PRUNING] Apply 5-core filtering to all datasets using `CorePruning(5)` to remove users and items with fewer than 5 interactions.

3. [IMPLICIT CONVERSION] For MovieLens100K and Amazon2014VideoGames, convert explicit ratings to implicit feedback using `MakeImplicit(4)` (keeping only ratings > 3, i.e., ratings >= 4). HetrecLastFM is already implicit and does not need conversion.
4. [DATA SPLITTING - REPRODUCIBILITY] Use exactly 5 different random seeds for data splitting, controlled via `set_random_state(seed)` before each split. Loop over these 5 seeds.

5. [DATA SPLITTING - USER HOLDOUT] For each seed, apply user-based 80/20 holdout using `UserHoldout(validation_size=0.0, test_size=0.2)` to ensure each user has interactions in both train and test sets.
6. [ALGORITHMS] Configure exactly three algorithms via `ExperimentPlan.add_algorithm()`: `LensKit.PopScorer`, `LensKit.ItemKNNScorer`, and `LensKit.ImplicitMFScorer`.
7. [ALGORITHMS - DEFAULT HYPERPARAMETERS] Use default hyperparameters: ImplicitMFScorer (features=50, iterations=100), ItemKNNScorer (max_nbrs=30, min_nbrs=5), PopScorer (defaults).
8. [EVALUATION METRICS] Evaluate using `NDCG([1, 5, 10])` and `Precision([1, 5, 10])` metrics via the OmniRec `Evaluator`.

9. [STATISTICAL ANALYSIS] Collect results per (dataset, algorithm, seed) combination. Compute mean, standard deviation, and coefficient of variation (std/mean) of each metric across the 5 seeds for each (dataset, algorithm) pair.
